annotations.text:
Direction A, as chosen — "quiet paper". Warm off-white, Newsreader for screen titles over IBM Plex Sans, one deep-green accent, flat colour and hairline borders instead of heavy shadows. Red and amber are reserved entirely for deadline signalling, so category colours never fight them.

Start top-left and work right: Today, then the All list mid-planning-pass, then a task detail. The two desktop states are the bottom two rows.

Desktop, detail pane SHOWN. Sidebar, Today list, open task side by side — editing a field never navigates you away from the list.

The pane is dismissed from the "Hide" control top-left of it, or with the \ key. The keyboard legend sits bottom-right in both states.

Desktop, detail pane HIDDEN — the state you asked for. The freed width becomes "Everything else": every task not on Today, filling top-down in two columns and scrolling straight down. Nothing overflows sideways and there are no buckets.

This is the planning screen: Today on the left, the backlog on the right, and the small sun button on each backlog card lifts it into Today. The fourth card shows that button in its hover state.
